Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Unassign Or Pass Work
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
Integration Services
 > REST-Based Web Services
 > Work Web Services
 > Unassign Or Pass Work
    
    
    
        The Work Unit Unassign Web Service unassigns or pass the entire work unit.


     Request



    
        URI: https://servername//ilsIntegrationServices/workUnits/assign?workUnit={workUnit}

        Method: DELETE

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                200 OK will be accompanied by an entity that represents the successfully unassigns work instruction: JSON, XML
            

            
                400

                Bad request can be expected if any exception occurred during processing or error.
